title: US Judge Won't Immediately Block Trump's Limiting Birthright Citizenship Order
summary_full: Boardman, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, said because the plaintiffs' lawsuit did not even mention Trump's 2026 order, she was unable to block it from being implemented at this time.
